description: Resume up to 100 paused monitors in one call, all or nothing; each goes back to PENDING and is checked on the next tick. For one monitor use resume_monitor; to run a check right away on a monitor that is already running, use check_now. Requires a key with the write scope. Resuming more monitors than the plan's active limit allows is a 403 and nothing changes (see get_plan_usage). A monitor already running is left as it is. Returns monitors: the list_monitors rows after the change, in request order. Example: {"monitor_ids": ["<id from list_monitors>", "<id from list_monitors>"]}

monitor_ids.description: 1 to 100 distinct monitor uuids from list_monitors. A repeated id is a 422; an id that is not a monitor of this organization is a 404 naming it, and then nothing changes.

name: bulk_resume_monitors

status.description: Known values: PENDING, UP, DEGRADED, DOWN, PAUSED.

type.description: Known values: HTTP, PING, SSL, TCP, DNS.

title: Resume many monitors
